The starting point

The work has a person behind it.

My work crosses disciplines. I wanted the identity to hold them together without making me sound like a faceless studio. It needed the confidence to stand out and enough warmth to make a conversation feel natural.

The work covered

  • Personal positioning and voice
  • Custom HTML/CSS wordmark
  • Five-colour system and typography
  • Website and content direction

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

A custom lowercase wordmark and lime diamond tittle give the name its signature. Mulberry provides the foundation; pink brings personality; cream leaves the work space to speak. Manrope, DM Sans and an occasional italic keep the tone expressive and readable.

The words

Serious skill. Big personality.

The balance matters. The work should feel considered; the person should still come through. That principle guides the websites, the writing and the way I introduce both.
